$comment: Mutation arms cutting the types of package devkit. Format and rules: docs/testing.md, Declared arms.

arms.name: M-BRANCHES-SHARE-WHOLE
arms.note: the suite's shards and the arms' jobs take the whole lease beside the rows already holding threads, so the slice gate oversubscribes the lease it runs under

arms.name: M-BRANCHES-FOREIGN-REPORT
arms.note: a report an earlier run's orphaned branch left under the same name is read as this run's, so a branch that died without reporting shows the old run's verdict

arms.name: M-BRANCHES-LIGHT-NONE
arms.note: the light branches hold nothing in the reckoning, so the heavy branch asks the pool for the whole budget beside the leases the lint and the probes take, and the gate's branches oversubscribe the machine

arms.name: M-LEASE-NEST-UNDER-HELD
arms.note: a run under its caller's lease asks the pool for more, so a waiter queued ahead of it for the threads it holds waits for ever

arms.name: M-BRANCHES-LIGHT-NOT-AHEAD
arms.find: { min: threads, max: threads, priority: ahead }
arms.note: the light branches queue at the heavy one's priority, so on a busy pool the heavy one's whole-share wait closes the free threads to its own siblings and the lint and the probes wait for the pool to drain

arms.name: M-COMMAND-SHORT-DRIVEN
arms.note: every git the tools run starts a node process driver first, so the gate's git-heavy classes pay a node start per call

arms.name: M-BRANCHES-HEAVY-NOT-SPLIT
arms.note: each heavy branch of a gate asks for the whole rest of the lease, so the suite and the base suite beside it oversubscribe the threads the lease holds

arms.name: M-LEASE-EST-EMITTED
arms.note: a flexible lease never tells the pool its per-size estimate, so the pool picks the size by waiting for the whole share

arms.name: M-LEASE-EST-ONLY-WITH-CURVE
arms.note: a lease whose curve holds a size without a time still sends the flag, which the pool refuses with exit 64 and no lease

arms.name: M-LEASE-EST-NONE-WITHOUT-CURVE
arms.find: if (seconds == null || ask.min >= ask.max) return null;
arms.note: a lease with no curve still sends an empty flag, which the pool refuses with exit 64 and no lease
